addr: 862, 6th Cross Rd, 6th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t: I was taken in this shop by a friend, and since then i loved the collection. The designs are unique and the fabric is of high quality. Infact unfortunately while shopping, i kept my silver chain in the changing room and left, but the salesperson kept it safe and even coordinated properly for returning it back

The collection at this boutique is stunning — unique designs and great quality. Unfortunately, the salesperson on duty made the experience unpleasant. Her tone turned impatient and dismissive, making me feel like I was wasting her time, …

This place has some really pretty decor places to add an aesthetic flavour to living spaces. Also, the handmade jwellery here are really unique and a perfect gifting option for anyone who loves jwellery
